summary: The TypeScript compiles and Playwright APIs are used correctly. However, the selector '[data-test="product-1"]' appears hardcoded for a single product, limiting test scalability. The navigation URL assertion is a regex match for '/product/' but does not confirm a specific product detail page. The test titles do not include the corresponding test case IDs, which reduces traceability. Overall, tests are functional but would benefit from stronger navigation validation and improved test title naming. No critical failures found.

issues.description: Selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is hardcoded to one specific product, reducing test coverage and reusability.
issues.recommendation: Use parameterized selectors or roles that can handle multiple products dynamically to increase test coverage.

issues.description: Navigation URL assertion uses a weak regex '/\/product\//' which only verifies the URL path contains 'product' but not which product detail page is opened.
issues.recommendation: Use a more specific URL check or assert presence of product-specific details on the page after navigation.

issues.description: Test case IDs (TC-001, TC-003) are not included in the test titles.
issues.recommendation: Include testCaseId values in test titles for better traceability between manual and automated tests.

recommendations: Parametrize selectors to support multiple product cards and increase test reusability.
Strengthen navigation assertions to verify the correct product detail page is opened.
Include test case IDs in test titles to map manual cases to automated tests effectively.
